command: PYTHONPATH=src venv/bin/python -m tar_system.cli run-paper-signal --strategy liquidity_sweep_v1 --symbol XAUUSD --timeframe M15
notes: This generates paper signals only and writes runtime/latest_paper_signal.json plus runtime/paper_signal_alerts.jsonl.
Use cron, launchd, or the dashboard scheduler to call this every 15 minutes.
